claims.claim_text: Mathematics was never the production of proofs but the judgment of which patterns deserve proving
claims.evidence_quote: mathematics was never the production of theorems. It was a process of thinking
claims.reasoning: Source states math was never theorem production and that importance (which patterns matter) was always the constraint. Identical thesis, rephrased.

claims.claim_text: Mathematics was the discipline of finding provable patterns with expert-settled ground truth
claims.evidence_quote: Mathematics is the discipline of finding patterns where claims can be proven
claims.reasoning: Direct restatement of the old definition plus the expert-settlement sentence that follows it in source.

claims.claim_text: Unlike art, politics, or physics, math offered ground truth instead of opinions
claims.evidence_quote: That was what made math different from art criticism, politics, business... Everything else had opinions. Math had ground truth
claims.reasoning: Source lists art criticism, politics, physics among opinion fields contrasted with math ground truth. Same meaning.

claims.claim_text: A professor's viral post likened AI-era research to grading a lying grade-grubber
claims.evidence_quote: his research has started to feel like grading the proofs of a very clever student who is desperate to get an A and doesn't mind lying
claims.reasoning: Source describes the professor's post with the grading-a-lying-student image. Faithful compression.

claims.claim_text: In 2026 AI produced publication-quality proofs of novel problems for hundreds of dollars
claims.evidence_quote: solved seven of ten unpublished problems to publication quality, for ten to a thousand dollars of compute each
claims.reasoning: Publication quality and novelty match, but source range is ten to a thousand dollars while claim narrows to hundreds. Changed scope, low impact.

claims.claim_text: Four systems solved seven of ten unpublished problems; choosing problems resisted automation
claims.evidence_quote: four leading systems solved seven of ten unpublished problems... the one step they could not automate was choosing the problems
claims.reasoning: Numbers 4 and 7-of-10 exact, and the choosing-problems exception stated verbatim in meaning.

claims.claim_text: AI proved Erdos 728 in Lean and disproved the 1946 unit-distance conjecture; humans digested both
claims.evidence_quote: produced a machine-checked Lean proof of Erdős Problem #728, and in May 2026 an OpenAI model disproved the planar unit distance conjecture Erdős had posed in 1946
claims.reasoning: Both 2026 results with dates and human-verified/digested framing match source body and appendix.

claims.claim_text: Models prove what humans choose; which patterns matter stays human, with handholding
claims.evidence_quote: That which patterns were worth chasing, is still human, and the models prove what we want them to prove. Although they still might need a lot of handholding
claims.reasoning: Both halves (human choice of patterns, models needing handholding) directly stated in source.

claims.claim_text: Conjecture generators propose patterns but never decide which ones matter
claims.evidence_quote: they propose patterns, they do not decide which ones matter
claims.reasoning: Near-verbatim restatement of source sentence on conjecture generators.

claims.claim_text: Proving may have been the chore all along; the finding was always the real thing
claims.evidence_quote: maybe the proving was the chore and the finding was always the real thing?!
claims.reasoning: Source poses this as a hedged question and claim keeps the hedge with may. Identical meaning.

claims.claim_text: The argument assumes mathematics is what humans do, like a self-justifying faith
claims.evidence_quote: I'm implicitely assuming mathematics 'is what we humans do'. Like a religion that assumes the god is the right thing
claims.reasoning: Faith/religion analogy and the humans-do assumption both stated in source.

claims.claim_text: Proof verification, the process's second half, is being automated too
claims.evidence_quote: Verifying the proof is often implicitly part of the proof process, and that is being automated too
claims.reasoning: Direct restatement of source section thesis on verification automation.

claims.claim_text: Davies-style intuition pumps and AlphaTensor show AI proposing, humans formalizing
claims.evidence_quote: The pattern is the same every time: the AI proposes, humans check, digest, and present
claims.reasoning: Source summarizes Davies results and AlphaTensor with exactly this propose-then-formalize pattern.

claims.claim_text: Understanding shifts from reconstructing proofs to interpreting opaque machine results
claims.evidence_quote: understanding shifts from constructive to hermeneutic. The mathematician becomes less a builder and more an interpreter
claims.reasoning: Constructive-to-hermeneutic shift restated with same meaning; opaque process stated in source.

claims.claim_text: Tao's hypothesis covers verification too; the question is tolerated error level
claims.evidence_quote: Tao's Working Hypothesis covers performing mathematical tasks, and verifying is one. So... what level of error we tolerate in it
claims.reasoning: Both halves directly stated in the verification section opening.

claims.claim_text: Deligne found Voevodsky's key lemma wrong years later; a main theorem failed unchallenged for years
claims.evidence_quote: they found that the proof of a key lemma was wrong... had a main theorem that was eventually shown to be false... nobody noticed for years
claims.reasoning: Lemma error, false main theorem, and years-long non-detection all stated in source.

claims.claim_text: Frightened Voevodsky spent his career pushing computer verification over human trust
claims.evidence_quote: Voevodsky was scared by this... He spent the rest of his career pushing for computer proof verification, because he no longer trusted the human process
claims.reasoning: Fear motive and career-long push for computer verification directly stated.

claims.claim_text: Human verification is unreliable, so comparable AI error rates look like business as usual
claims.evidence_quote: Human verification is not reliable... So when AI verification arrives with an error rate comparable to that... It will look like business as usual
claims.reasoning: Calibration argument restated with identical meaning.

claims.claim_text: The AI-side error rate is assumed, not measured, and machine volume compounds mistakes
claims.evidence_quote: The AI-side rate is assumed, not measured, and the volume compounds: years to surface a mistake by hand, a million checks a day by machine
claims.reasoning: Assumed-not-measured caveat and volume compounding both stated verbatim in meaning.

claims.claim_text: Mathematics was never theorem production; the thinking process was the product
claims.evidence_quote: mathematics was never the production of theorems. It was a process of thinking, and the process was the product
claims.reasoning: Near-verbatim restatement of the section thesis.

claims.claim_text: Teaching math builds judgment through struggle; fluency must not be confused with understanding
claims.evidence_quote: not the facts, the struggle... risks equating exposure to an idea with understanding it. They are not the same
claims.reasoning: Struggle-building-habit and fluency-versus-ownership points both stated in source.

claims.claim_text: Cognitive offloading and confident AI tone worsen the illusion of explanatory depth
claims.evidence_quote: Cognitive offloading is the tendency to delegate mental effort... illusion of explanatory depth is the way fluency gets confused with ownership... confident tone
claims.reasoning: Both named effects and the confident-tone twist stated in source.

claims.claim_text: Thinking is constitutive, not instrumental like laundry or car repair
claims.evidence_quote: Thinking is constitutive... Fixing a car is instrumental. You want the fixed car, not the experience of fixing it
claims.reasoning: Constitutive-versus-instrumental distinction with laundry/car examples restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Arithmetic, poetry, and navigation losses were survivable; the chore-thinking boundary is blurry
claims.evidence_quote: We said the same things about mental arithmetic, memorizing poetry, navigation. Some of those losses turned out fine... the boundary is blurry
claims.reasoning: Concession with the same three examples and blurry-boundary conclusion stated in source.

claims.claim_text: GPS atrophies spatial memory, but framing and attention look load-bearing; proving trains finding
claims.evidence_quote: the atrophying of spatial reasoning under GPS is decently documented... Problem framing, noticing what's missing... look load-bearing... proving is the gym where the finding is trained
claims.reasoning: GPS finding, load-bearing list, and proving-as-gym all stated; no study numbers claimed so none drift.

claims.claim_text: Over-polished AI proofs dwell on trivia, rush novelty, and remove the friction readers need
claims.evidence_quote: They dwell on trivialities and rush past the novel parts... remove friction... the reader sails through without learning the key ideas
claims.reasoning: All three exposition failures stated in source Tao summary.

claims.claim_text: Thurston: success is enabling clearer thought, not meeting quotas of theorems
claims.evidence_quote: The measure of our success is whether what we do enables people to understand and think more clearly
claims.reasoning: Accurate compression of the quoted Thurston passage.

claims.claim_text: Once struggle stops being scarce, the community must ask what it optimizes for
claims.evidence_quote: Once the struggle stops being scarce, he asks, what is the community actually optimizing for?
claims.reasoning: Direct restatement of the transition sentence to Tao's pipeline.

claims.claim_text: Tao assumes capable AI and asks what goals and values the community actually pursues
claims.evidence_quote: He states a Working Hypothesis... then he asks the orthogonal question: what are the goals and values of the mathematical community
claims.reasoning: Conditional hypothesis plus values question both stated.

claims.claim_text: The Working Hypothesis asks belief be suspended; the values question belongs to the humanities
claims.evidence_quote: He asks you not to believe it, only to assume it... This is the question math has historically delegated to the humanities
claims.reasoning: Suspended-belief framing and humanities delegation both stated.

claims.claim_text: Goodhart's law threatens correlated goals: AI optimization breaks their old proxies
claims.evidence_quote: when a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure... AI optimization threatens to break the correlation
claims.reasoning: Goodhart statement and correlation-breaking claim restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Solving needs verifying, exposition, acceptance, canonicalization; AI piles stall at each stage
claims.evidence_quote: Refine it once, add verification... add exposition... add community acceptance... add canonicalization... mismatches appear at every stage
claims.reasoning: Four refinement stages and per-stage mismatch stated in source case study.

claims.claim_text: Under proof abundance the bottleneck is digestion, today's lowest-prestige work
claims.evidence_quote: The bottleneck shifts to proof digestion, and digestion is the work we currently treat as low prestige
claims.reasoning: Bottleneck shift and low-prestige status directly stated.

claims.claim_text: Tao urges disclosure norms, less first-past-posting, and a clear-talk rule for publication
claims.evidence_quote: normalize responsible disclosure of AI assistance, decrease the emphasis on generation and on being first... if the authors cannot... give a clear, expert-level talk... then the result should not be published
claims.reasoning: All three recommendations (disclosure, de-emphasize first, talk rule) stated in source.

claims.claim_text: The research-loving professor demoted to grading embodies Tao's prestige inversion
claims.evidence_quote: The professor in that LinkedIn post is the human version of this. He got into research because he loved producing and hated grading
claims.reasoning: Source explicitly casts the professor as the human version of the prestige inversion.

claims.claim_text: Importance was never stable human judgment; AI removes the cover story
claims.evidence_quote: I think importance was never a stable, purely human judgment... The AI era removes the cover story
claims.reasoning: Blind-spot thesis restated with identical meaning.

claims.claim_text: Applicability steered work through funding for results wanted elsewhere
claims.evidence_quote: Did a problem solve something real elsewhere... it was partly driven by where research funding lived. Money went to areas where results were wanted
claims.reasoning: First lever (applicability via funding) restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Big-name taste compounded fame, genuine interest, and network favoritism
claims.evidence_quote: Partly fame... Partly genuine interest. And partly network favoritism
claims.reasoning: All three taste components stated in source.

claims.claim_text: The author leans on Tao and Moradifam, the very authorities he says to interrogate
claims.evidence_quote: I should own the irony of saying this while leaning on Tao and Moradifam... They are exactly the kind of authority I am saying we should interrogate
claims.reasoning: Author's owned irony restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Cheap generation makes attention scarce, and scarce attention grows influencer structure
claims.evidence_quote: generating a result and verifying it both become cheap. What stays scarce is attention, and markets for scarce attention develop influencer structure
claims.reasoning: Cheap-production to scarce-attention to influencer-structure chain directly stated.

claims.claim_text: Writing gave way to clips and podcasts; supplements beat world affairs by relatability
claims.evidence_quote: the conversation moved away from writing toward video and voice, short-form clips and podcasts... more people are interested in food supplemants than they are in world affairs
claims.reasoning: Internet-to-social-media analogy with the supplements example restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Compute budgets and self-solving applications will set the agenda; the shift takes decades
claims.evidence_quote: what problems are allocated computation money... will all be defined differently... it might take years, probably decades, not months
claims.reasoning: Compute allocation plus self-solving-fields mechanism and decades timing all stated.

claims.claim_text: Canonizing attention is a private act with public consequences that nobody audits
claims.evidence_quote: their attention allocation is a public good when it is actually a private act with public consequences... Nobody audits whether the redirection was optimal
claims.reasoning: Private-act framing and no-audit claim directly stated.

claims.claim_text: Old gatekeepers earned structural trust through decades of checkable work and slow feedback
claims.evidence_quote: their standing was built over decades of checkable work... Feedback loops were slow, audiences were small
claims.reasoning: Structural-trust explanation (decades of checkable work, slow low-visibility loops) restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Measurable influence gets optimized, diverging from the judgment it once proxied
claims.evidence_quote: The moment influence becomes measurable and monetizable, it gets optimized for, and the optimization target diverges from the thing it proxied
claims.reasoning: Measurement-trap mechanism restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Simulated canons turn on exposure pipelines; unread results are inert, so gates control existence
claims.evidence_quote: Reshuffle who has access to the exposure pipeline and you get almost entirely different canons... a result that nobody reads is inert
claims.reasoning: Canon simulation result and inert-unread-result claim both stated.

claims.claim_text: Checkability floors and structural value ceilings claims; the social middle decides careers
claims.evidence_quote: The floor is checkability... The ceiling is structural value... What the social layer decides is the vast middle... the middle is where almost every career lives
claims.reasoning: Floor-ceiling-middle structure restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Attention-optimized AI picks viral results, feeding back into problem selection and frozen canons
claims.evidence_quote: the AI tools optimize for attention, so results get chosen and framed for virality... feeds back into which problems are posed next... biases exist in today's canon get frozen in and amplified
claims.reasoning: Goodhart recursion (virality optimization, feedback to selection, frozen biases) restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Open collaboration and expert checkable audiences expanded judgment; AI changes that audience
claims.evidence_quote: Polymath-style open collaboration... expanded who could participate in judgment... The danger with AI is that it changes the audience
claims.reasoning: Counter-doom concession with the audience-change danger both stated.

claims.claim_text: Agreement without shared reasoning is coincidence wearing confirmation's costume
claims.evidence_quote: Agreement without shared reasoning is coincidence wearing the costume of confirmation
claims.reasoning: Near-verbatim restatement of the section thesis.

claims.claim_text: Different paths to one conclusion give corroboration or expose broken reasoning needing rechecks
claims.evidence_quote: If their path is sound and different from yours, you now have two independent lines of support... If their path is broken... your own arrival at it needs at least a recheck
claims.reasoning: Delta-information mechanism (corroboration versus recheck) restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Atiyah's authority failed against scrutiny on Riemann; imagine a million daily AI claims
claims.evidence_quote: this also reminds me of Atiyah's last claim about proving the Riemann Hypothesis... it was put under harsh scrutiny, and it didn't stand up. Now imagine a million of these every day
claims.reasoning: Atiyah example and million-a-day scaling both stated.

claims.claim_text: Attention strips reasoning in transit; fluent AI answers are conclusions without process
claims.evidence_quote: it propagates conclusions at high velocity while reasoning... gets stripped in transit... an AI answer is the limit case of conclusion without process
claims.reasoning: Stripped-in-transit mechanism and AI limit-case claim both stated.

claims.claim_text: Like the unheard falling tree, unexamined consensus leaves meaning unresolved
claims.evidence_quote: this also reminds me of the the thought experiment of a tree falling in a jungle
claims.reasoning: Source only name-drops the tree thought experiment as somewhat related; the unexamined-consensus moral is the outline's gloss, not the source's stated conclusion.

claims.claim_text: Mathematics is finding plus proving; automation shifts weight to deciding what matters
claims.evidence_quote: It was always both: finding patterns, and proving them... I am speculating that the mix is shifting: as proving and verification get automated, the weight moves to deciding which patterns matter
claims.reasoning: Both-and answer plus shifting-mix speculation restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Correctness was the floor; importance, a social judgment, was always the constraint
claims.evidence_quote: Correctness was never the binding constraint... It was the floor. The constraint was always importance
claims.reasoning: Floor-versus-constraint framing restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Grant-funded detours get published while the big promised problem stays quietly unsolved
claims.evidence_quote: A scientist writes a grant proposal for a big important problem, gets funded... then publishes whatever detour they ended up on, and the big problem quietly stays unsolved
claims.reasoning: Grant-detour observation restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Engineers already turned deciders; open source runs on love, frameworks on attention
claims.evidence_quote: Software engineering already made this turn... open source runs on love, the framework wars run on attention, and software is already the two futures at once
claims.reasoning: Software-turn analogy with love-versus-attention line restated identically.

claims.claim_text: The deciding has no professional home: fun hobby, influencer economy, or compute owners
claims.evidence_quote: Either theoretical mathematics becomes a fun activity... or it becomes part of an influencer economy... or whoever owns the compute it runs on
claims.reasoning: Three landing options restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Statistics survived cheap calculation by becoming the design of questions
claims.evidence_quote: Statistics went through the same turn when arithmetic got cheap... deciding which questions matter became the discipline itself
claims.reasoning: Statistics precedent restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Halmos won fame for exposition, proving the middle can be revalued
claims.evidence_quote: the Halmos lesson: the community made a man famous for exposition, so the middle can be revalued if it wants to be
claims.reasoning: Halmos-for-exposition precedent restated identically.

claims.claim_text: CNC and Ikea emptied furniture's middle; creative carpenters cannot earn creativity
claims.evidence_quote: the carpenter who wants to be creative can't make a living at it anymore
claims.reasoning: Woodworking-middle claim with identical meaning; cannot-earn-creativity matches cannot-make-a-living.

claims.claim_text: AI software multiplies starts but kills finishes; the craft middle is the desert
claims.evidence_quote: The volume of starts goes up, the number of finishes goes down, and the middle, where the craft lives, is the desert
claims.reasoning: Starts-up finishes-down plus desert-middle restated identically.

claims.claim_text: Digestion work must not empty like furniture's middle, or results lose legibility
claims.evidence_quote: If we let it empty out the way furniture's middle emptied, mathematics keeps producing results while losing the people who make them legible, checkable, and taught
claims.reasoning: Warning conditional directly implies the must-not-empty recommendation with same consequence.

claims.claim_text: Thinking is what we are for; a coach-only sport loses performance when lifters stop lifting
claims.evidence_quote: Thinking is what we are for... A coach who only ever coaches robots, who never lifts again, keeps the taste and loses the performance
claims.reasoning: Airport-ad moral plus coach-versus-lifter gym metaphor restated identically.
